### Owner
- **Definition**: Sets **strategic direction**, has **full visibility**, and holds **final authority** across the system.  
- **Source**: `docs/by-role/owner.md` (Focus), `docs/system/role-and-area-responsibilities.md` (top of hierarchy; primary **S** in many areas)

### Administrator
- **Definition**: Owns **systems oversight**—keeps operations healthy via **configuration, standards, and procedural quality**.  
- **Source**: `docs/by-role/administrator.md`

### Commercial
- **Definition**: Drives **growth and revenue**—**new business**, **client relationships**, and **intelligence-led commercial decisions**.  
- **Source**: `docs/by-role/commercial.md`

### Coordinator
- **Definition**: Runs **delivery coordination**—aligns **clients, contributors, commercial, and admin** to keep **tasks and deliverables on track**.  
- **Source**: `docs/by-role/coordinator.md`

### Contributor
- **Definition**: Executes the work—**builds deliverables** and follows the **canonical playbooks and templates**.  
- **Source**: `docs/by-role/contributor.md`

### Investor
- **Definition**: **External stakeholder** providing **capital and strategic context**; **not part of day-to-day** supervision/do ownership in the S/D matrix.  
- **Source**: `docs/by-role/investor.md`, `docs/system/role-and-area-responsibilities.md` (Investor outside matrix)
